Twenty, one hundred, or three hundred dollars a month.
Each budget buys a different shape of team.
Under twenty dollars: one main office on an entry plan, plus free tools like GitHub for your website code.
If you're in the US, Claude Pro gets you on the Duet waitlist.
Or an entry SuperGrok plan includes Grok Bot.
Around one hundred: a stronger main office, like Claude's entry Max tier, plus one specialist.
Cursor Premium covers the website and brings Grok Bot with it.
Around three hundred: two offices and a department of agents, led by Claude, OpenAI or Grok.
Only spend this when agents replace real hours, like inbox triage, bookkeeping prep and weekly reports.
Whatever the tier, review every ninety days, and cancel any plan you didn't open last month.
